arxiv-2009-10109.creator: Niharika Agrawal, Abhishek Ambede, S. J. Darak, A. P. Vinod, A. S. Madhukumar
arxiv-2009-10109.description: Abstract L L -band Digital Aeronautical Communication System (LDACS) aims to exploit vacant spectrum in L L -band via spectrum sharing, and orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) is the currently accepted LDACS waveform. Recently, various works dealing with improving the spectrum utilization of LDACS via filtering/windowing are being explored.

Rangan were supported by NSF grants 1952180, 2133662, 2236097, 2148293, 1925079, the NTIA, and the industrial affiliates of NYU WIRELESS. G. Geraci was supported by the Spanish Resea
arxiv-2311-12965.creator: Seongjoon Kang † Giovanni Geraci ♯ Marco Mezzavilla † Sundeep Rangan †
arxiv-2311-12965.description: Abstract The growing demand for broader bandwidth in cellular networks has turned the upper mid-band (7–24 GHz) into a focal point for expansion. However, the integration of terrestrial cellular and incumbent satellite services, particularly in the 12 GHz band, poses significant interference challenges.

arxiv-2405-16420.title: M-RAG: Reinforcing Large Language Model Performance through Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Multiple Partitions
arxiv-2405-16420.creator: Zheng Wang, Shu Xian Teo, Jieer Ouyang, Yongjun Xu, Wei Shi
arxiv-2405-16420.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zheng Wang, Shu Xian Teo, Jieer Ouyang, Yongjun Xu, Wei Shi. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances Large Language Models (LLMs) by retrieving relevant memories from an external database. However, existing RAG methods typically organize all memories in a whole database, potentially limiting focus on crucial memories and introducing noise. In this paper, we introduce a multiple partition paradigm for RAG (called M-RAG ), where each database partition serves as a basic unit for RAG execution.

arxiv-2409-17153.title: A generalized Apollonius problem
arxiv-2409-17153.creator: AZIZKHON AZIZOV, SEMYON LITVINOV
arxiv-2409-17153.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by AZIZKHON AZIZOV, SEMYON LITVINOV. We present a self-contained solution of a generalized Apollonius problem of constructing a circle that intersects each of the three pair-wise non-intersecting circles at one of the three given angles.

arxiv-2411-12221.title: Non-adiabatic phonon self-energy due to electrons with finite linewidths
arxiv-2411-12221.creator: Cheol-Hwan Park
arxiv-2411-12221.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Cheol-Hwan Park. We develop the theory of the non-adiabatic phonon self-energy arising from coupling to electrons with finite linewidths using the spectral representation of Green’s functions. Our formalism naturally includes the contribution from the intra-band electronic transitions (as well as the inter-band ones) at all electron wavevectors to the phonon linewidths, which is forbidden for zone-center optical phonons if infinitesimal electron linewidths are used.

arxiv-2503-06963.title: Multi-Behavior Recommender Systems: A Survey
arxiv-2503-06963.creator: Kyungho Kim, Sunwoo Kim, Geon Lee, Jinhong Jung, Kijung Shin (✉)
arxiv-2503-06963.description: Abstract Traditional recommender systems primarily rely on a single type of user-item interaction, such as item purchases or ratings, to predict user preferences. However, in real-world scenarios, users engage in a variety of behaviors, such as clicking on items or adding them to carts, offering richer insights into their interests.

arxiv-2509-01335.title: Identification of the transport regimes of the one-dimensional Holstein model
arxiv-2509-01335.creator: Suzana Miladić, Nenad Vukmirović
arxiv-2509-01335.description: Abstract The Holstein model is a benchmark model of systems with electron-phonon interaction. However, its electrical transport properties are not yet fully understood. In this work, we performed numerically exact calculations of imaginary-time current-current correlation function of the Holstein Hamiltonian for a broad range of model parameters. These calculations were performed using a path-integral based Quantum Monte Carlo method.

pmc-10649166.description: Minerals play an important role in maintaining human health as the deficiency of these minerals can lead to serious health issues. pmc-10795832.title: Intratumoral aluminum hydroxide–anchored IL-12 drives potent antitumor activity by remodeling the tumor microenvironment
pmc-10795832.creator: Sailaja Battula, Gregory Papastoitsis, Howard L Kaufman, K Dane Wittrup, Michael M Schmidt
pmc-10795832.description: IL-12 is a potent cytokine that can promote innate and adaptive anticancer immunity, but its clinical development has been limited by toxicity when delivered systemically. Intratumoral (i.t.) administration can expand the therapeutic window of IL-12 and other cytokines but is in turn limited by rapid drug clearance from the tumor, which reduces efficacy, necessitates frequent administration, and increases systemic accumulation.

pmc-11504554.title: Frequency-Dependent Antioxidant Responses in HT-1080 Human Fibrosarcoma Cells Exposed to Weak Radio Frequency Fields
pmc-11504554.creator: Hakki Gurhan, Frank Barnes, Alessandra Napolitano, Jean Paul Jay-Gerin
pmc-11504554.description: This study explores the complex relationship between radio frequency (RF) exposure and cancer cells, focusing on the HT-1080 human fibrosarcoma cell line. We investigated the modulation of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and key antioxidant enzymes, including superoxide dismutase (SOD), peroxidase, and glutathione (GSH), as well as mitochondrial superoxide levels and cell viability.

pmc-12573638.title: Toward a plant biotechnological application of phyllosphere bacteria
pmc-12573638.creator: Rikako Hirata, Yuga Fujinawa, Akira Mine
pmc-12573638.description: The phyllosphere, referring to the leaf-dominated aerial parts of plants, represents a vast yet challenging habitat for plant-associated bacteria.
